field.label: Enabled
field.help: Send the scheduled reports and alerts. When disabled nothing is mailed, but previews still work.

field.label: Network name
field.help: Shown in the report heading and the mail subject.

field.label: Default recipients
field.help: Used by every schedule that has no recipients of its own. When empty, the mail account's own address is used.

field.label: Alert language
field.help: This is NOT the language of the reports. Each schedule carries its own, shown in the Language column on the Schedules tab, and a report only follows the system language when that schedule is set to System language. This field is the language of the instant alerts and the test message.

field.label: Mail server
field.help: Reuse the mail server already configured under Services: Monit, or enter a separate SMTP server.

field.label: SMTP port
field.help: Usually 465 for SSL/TLS or 587 for STARTTLS.

field.label: Password
field.help: Stored on this firewall only. Leave empty to keep the current password.

field.label: Internet interface
field.help: Used for internet volume and the monthly data cap.

field.label: Local network
field.help: Devices on this network are listed in the report and watched for new arrivals.

field.label: VPN tunnels
field.help: Traffic and state of these tunnels are included in the report.

field.label: New device alert
field.help: Send a short message within five minutes when a device joins the local network for the first time.

field.label: Backup age warning (days)
field.help: Warn when the last remote configuration backup is older than this. 0 disables the check.

field.label: Monthly data cap (GB)
field.help: Download and upload together. Warns at 80% and 100%. 0 means unlimited.

field.label: Keep sent reports (days)
field.help: Copies of sent reports stay on the firewall for this many days and can be opened from the history tab. 0 keeps none.
